results.canonical_news_title: The CRA Single Reporting Platform is launched

global_competitors.name: CVD Portal
global_competitors.reason: CRA manufacturer workspace covering disclosure intake, product assessment, Article 14 deadline reporting and audit evidence.

global_competitors.name: CRA Compliance Wizard
global_competitors.reason: Product/release record with vulnerability case management, PSIRT reporting workflow, evidence, approvals and post-market deadlines.

global_competitors.name: alloy-it
global_competitors.reason: Manufacturer CRA operations product with PSIRT alerts, decisions/evidence and explicit 24h/72h/14-day reporting clocks.

adjacent_competitors.name: ENISA SRP
adjacent_competitors.reason: Official filing destination, not internal manufacturer PSIRT case-management software.

competition_search_terms: CRA PSIRT software vulnerability reporting workflow
Cyber Resilience Act case management 24h 72h evidence
results.market_gap: No defensible gap at core workflow level; multiple 2026 products already turn CRA vulnerability handling into deadline/evidence workflows.
results.mvp: Product registry, vulnerability intake, deadline clock, supplier/evidence tasks, notification drafts and audit export.
results.working_logic: Open case; identify affected product/release; start CRA clocks; collect evidence; assign remediation/supplier tasks; prepare filing and retain audit trail.
results.marketing_strategy: EU exporters, product-security consultancies and PSIRT communities.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with a connected-product SME exporting to EU.
results.main_risk: Category already populated by CRA-native products.
results.validation_assumption: CVD Portal, CRA Compliance Wizard and alloy-it meet same customer/job/workflow test.
results.local_applicability_rationale: Çerkezköy industrial corridor has electronics/electrical-equipment and machinery manufacturers, including export-oriented machinery, so the buyer type exists in Trakya; this does not overcome direct competition or justify Lüleburgaz specifically.
results.rejection_reason: At least three direct global CRA/PSIRT workflow products already provide vulnerability case handling, deadlines, evidence and reporting.

global_competitors.name: Regilient
global_competitors.reason: Classification decision flow with evidence/notes, four-eyes approval, change history and audit-ready classification packs.

global_competitors.name: KYG Trade ChatECN
global_competitors.reason: Classification workflow with human work queues, permanent rationale report and audit trail.

global_competitors.name: Descartes Visual Compliance
global_competitors.reason: Dedicated export-classification workflow application covering controlled-product classifications.

global_competitors.name: OCR EASE
global_competitors.reason: Rules-based classification with cross-team review/approval and immutable decision/justification history.

competition_search_terms: export control classification workflow approval audit trail
results.market_gap: The exact classification-request→evidence→human approval→reusable rationale workflow is mature global-trade software functionality.
results.mvp: Case intake, classification checklist, evidence, draft determination, reviewer approval and rationale history.
results.working_logic: Create request; collect technical/end-use facts; apply rule checklist; draft classification; human approve; retain rationale for reuse/audit.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with a manufacturer repeatedly classifying controlled technical products.
results.main_risk: Strong specialized incumbents with maintained regulatory content.
results.validation_assumption: Four products satisfy strict direct definition.
results.local_applicability_rationale: Candidate is global export-control workflow; no Lüleburgaz claim.
results.rejection_reason: Multiple mature export-control products already implement structured classification, evidence, review/approval and audit history.

results.canonical_news_title: Neura Robotics expands into healthcare with autonomous hospital transport robot

global_competitors.name: Elvio Robotics
global_competitors.reason: Vendor-independent hospital fleet software centrally coordinates transport/logistics robots across manufacturers and hospital infrastructure.

global_competitors.name: Genetix Hospital Logistics Robots
global_competitors.reason: Hospital logistics workflow includes on-demand/scheduled requests, fleet task assignment, route coordination and traceable operational records.

competition_search_terms: vendor neutral hospital robot fleet dispatch software
hospital logistics robot task dispatch fleet management
results.market_gap: Pilot ROI/exception logging could be an add-on, but dispatch eligibility and robot logistics coordination are already core hospital fleet-management functionality.
results.mvp: Transport request queue, eligibility rules, robot/human assignment, exception log, turnaround/ROI dashboard.
results.working_logic: Receive request; determine robot eligibility; assign robot or human; record exception and completion; aggregate pilot metrics.
results.marketing_strategy: Hospital facilities/logistics teams and robotics integrators.
results.first_customer_plan: Shadow-mode pilot alongside one hospital transport-robot deployment.
results.main_risk: Robot vendors/fleet platforms own the dispatch data and can add pilot analytics.
results.validation_assumption: Elvio and Genetix substantially cover same hospital operations job and dispatch workflow.
results.rejection_reason: Vendor-neutral and hospital-specific robot fleet platforms already coordinate the core transport dispatch workflow.

results.canonical_news_title: Looking beyond peak: Industry coalition floats new approach to measuring grid utilization

global_competitors.name: Ampacify
global_competitors.reason: Grid-capacity intelligence product explicitly compares connection pathways and plans flexible load with traceable evidence, closely matching large-load flexible-capacity scenario screening.

adjacent_competitors.name: Urdais Flexible Capacity
adjacent_competitors.reason: Computes counterfactual flexible-load headroom from observed demand; methodology/data product rather than site workflow.

adjacent_competitors.name: Logic20/20 Flexible Service Connection
adjacent_competitors.reason: Consulting/methodology for evaluating flexible capacity and integrating it into utility planning, not a clearly verified standalone product.

competition_search_terms: grid flexible capacity scenario software large load interconnection
interval data utilization flexible load site comparison software
results.market_gap: A lightweight CSV pre-feasibility calculator may be cheaper, but Ampacify directly addresses usable capacity, connection pathways and flexible-load evidence for the same planning decision.
results.mvp: Interval-data upload, standardized utilization metrics, flexible-load windows, site/scenario comparison and evidence report.
results.working_logic: Import interval series; calculate utilization; apply shift/curtailment scenarios; compare capacity opportunity; export assumptions/results.
results.marketing_strategy: Industrial energy consultants and large-load project developers.
results.first_customer_plan: Use one industrial interval-load dataset to produce a pre-feasibility report.
results.main_risk: Grid physics and local network constraints limit what a lightweight tool can validly claim.
results.validation_assumption: Ampacify meets strict same-job/workflow test sufficiently to reject the proposed wedge.
results.local_applicability_rationale: Trakya has a large, export-oriented industrial footprint and high-load manufacturing buyer types, but evidence does not justify Lüleburgaz-specific labeling.
results.rejection_reason: Ampacify already productizes flexible-load capacity, connection-pathway comparison and evidence-backed planning for the same core decision.

global_competitors.name: Precoro
global_competitors.reason: Procurement/inventory product explicitly pulls items from available stock instead of re-ordering and avoids duplicate purchases with real-time stock visibility; warehouse requests support inter-location movement.

global_competitors.name: Scatterlink
global_competitors.reason: Multi-location industrial inventory visibility explicitly helps procurement avoid duplicate purchases by seeing existing stock across warehouses/yards.

global_competitors.name: Tag RoBo Tech
global_competitors.reason: Procurement asset-visibility product is explicitly designed to prove idle capacity across sites before purchase orders and stop duplicate CapEx buys.

adjacent_competitors.name: TRACTIAN Spare Parts Management
adjacent_competitors.reason: Centralized multi-location spare-parts inventory, transfers and purchase requests; adjacent maintenance-focused implementation.

competition_search_terms: stock before buy procurement software multi site inventory
avoid duplicate purchases cross warehouse procurement
satın alma öncesi stok kontrolü depolar arası transfer yazılımı
results.market_gap: No defensible core-workflow gap: stock-first procurement and cross-site reuse/transfer are already explicit product features.
results.mvp: Request intake, normalized inventory search, reuse/transfer suggestion, approval and avoided-purchase ledger.
results.working_logic: Requester enters item; search all locations/contracts; suggest available stock/transfer; purchase only if no reusable stock; record avoided spend.
results.marketing_strategy: Multi-site manufacturers, mining/logistics and procurement communities.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with two warehouses and historical duplicate-buy examples.
results.main_risk: ERP/procurement/inventory vendors already own the workflow and source data.
results.validation_assumption: Precoro, Scatterlink and Tag RoBo satisfy same customer/job/substantially-same-workflow test.
results.local_applicability_rationale: The Çerkezköy/Kaplı corridor clearly contains multi-site industrial/manufacturing buyer types, but that only validates Trakya applicability; it does not establish Lüleburgaz scope.
results.rejection_reason: Multiple procurement/inventory products already implement stock visibility before buying, inter-site reuse/transfer and duplicate-purchase avoidance.
